Fwd: Celebrate Safely: Union City Fireworks Guidelines for the Fourth
 of July
body_preview: ---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Union City <UnionCity@public.govdelivery.com> Date: Thu, Jul 2, 2026, 3:00 PM Subject: Celebrate Safely: Union City Fireworks Guidelines for the Fourth of July To: <antonio.hudnall@gmail.com>   Celebrate Safely: Union City Fireworks Guidelines for the Fourth of July [image: Fireworks] Celebrate Safely: Union City Fireworks Guidelines for the Fourth of July  *UNION CITY, CA, July 2, 2026 - *As our nation’s 250th Anniversary approaches, Union City reminds residents to celebrate responsibly and make safety a top priority. Only *State Fire Marshal-approved “safe and sane”* fireworks are permitted in Union City, and their use must comply with local and state laws.  *Key Safety Guidelines:*     - Use fireworks only on private property with the *owner’s permission*,    July 1-4, from *8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.*    - Keep fireworks *at least 10 feet from any structure.*    - Always have adult supervision and a hose or water source
